Message requests and the listed page download as needed. If a foreground download fails before any body is available, the reader shows Retry download and leaves the message unread. A server response without the requested message is treated as a failed download. Partial cached content stays visible with a download warning and retry. While the app is awake/open, 00:00–07:00 local can add up to one indexed body after each background folder pass, within Mail & Sync history; trash, spam and drafts are excluded. Download failures still show Needs attention; encoding notices appear in the reader separately from download completeness; Gmail API handles MIME parts within its response limit. Ordinary attachment files stay on demand except the bounded original-MIME read used to resolve ambiguous Gmail text; that read includes attachment bytes without saving those files. Gmail decodes legacy mail encodings including cp932 and UTF-7, and retains ISO-2022-JP decoding. Malformed MIME leaves available content with an incomplete-body warning. Unknown charsets and decoding loss show an encoding notice without repeatedly downloading a complete message, and do not stop other messages from syncing. A source-limited message is not downloaded automatically again until its provider identity changes; Retry download explicitly tries again. Transient incomplete downloads wait at least 60 seconds before another automatic attempt. Overnight selection advances past previously attempted headers instead of stopping at the first 200. Each background pass scans at most two 200-header pages for a candidate, then keeps its cursor for the next pass, including across nightly windows while the app stays open.
